Chicago Yacht Club Skyline Panorama

Andy CASA, UCL East



Chicago's Yacht Club has been established since 1869. Located on the shores of Lake Michigan its backdrop is the skyline of Chicago.

The panorama was taken on the far jetty opposite the club, aiming to capture the skyline and the water front.

View the Quicktime panorama of the Chicago Skyline from the Yacht Club (2.1mb).
